descriptionMarkdown: This promethium ship was made using no belt storage or thruster stacking at all since i find them both "ugly" solutions and ups demanding as well. It was inspired by the work of others while doing it's own thing as well, using diagonal railgun turrets with a long line of 30 asteroid collectors between them. It is also wide while relatively low weight at 3775 tons. Finally it uses a passive belt overflow dumping system for all the excessive materials without logic circuits and it is optimized for 200.000 bitter eggs producing about 14.500/min promethium science on average. It's ground support is included.
title: Promethium ship - No belt storage/thruster stacking. 14500/min science.
